Press items for orientation. Do not cite this page for official project counts or for the HK$350 billion figure. Use Tracker.

## Update schedule

Every Sunday, 18:00 Hong Kong Time.

LAE-Intel drafts at most five Hong Kong or Greater Bay Area items from the previous seven days.

Items that lack a date or an outlet are dropped.

This page is updated only after the course instructor approves the draft.

Official counts and the HK$350 billion figure stay on Tracker.

## How items appear

Each item: date, outlet, one sentence, official document to read instead (if any).

## 2026-09

- **2026-09-23** — info.gov.hk (English GIA). STL Chan, with TLB Permanent Secretary and CAD Director-General, met CAAC Deputy Administrator Liang Nan in Beijing and discussed First Five-Year Plan / 2026 Policy Address aviation measures including the low-altitude economy (alongside trunk-branch connectivity, air cargo, and SAF). [Link](https://www.info.gov.hk/gia/general/202609/23/P2026092300422.htm). Official document to read instead: Working Group / TLB / CAD; Action Plan on Developing Low-Altitude Economy (text OPEN; PA-framed); SZ–HK corridor remains NOT evidenced on Tracker.

- **2026-09-23** — 政府新聞公報 (info.gov.hk Chinese GIA). Same Beijing CAAC call recorded in Chinese; 低空經濟 listed among discussion topics; no new Action Plan text or corridor announcement. [Link](https://www.info.gov.hk/gia/general/202609/23/P2026092300345.htm). Official document to read instead: Working Group / TLB / CAD; Action Plan (text OPEN).

- **2026-09-21** — HK01. STL Mable Chan and Housing Secretary Winnie Ho attended the launch of a Regulatory Sandbox drone meal-delivery route into Ma On Shan’s Chung On Estate (頌安邨)—the first public-housing landing—with Chan calling it a Regulatory Sandbox milestone and foreshadowing more Northern Metropolis estate routes. [Link](https://www.hk01.com/%E7%A4%BE%E6%9C%83%E6%96%B0%E8%81%9E/60392252/keeta%E7%84%A1%E4%BA%BA%E6%A9%9F%E9%A6%96%E9%A3%9B%E9%A6%AC%E9%9E%8D%E5%B1%B1%E9%A0%8C%E5%AE%89%E9%82%A8-%E5%85%A9%E5%B1%80%E9%95%B7%E9%A0%90%E5%91%8A%E9%A3%9B%E9%80%B2%E6%9B%B4%E5%A4%9A%E5%8C%97%E9%83%BD%E5%85%AC%E5%85%B1%E5%B1%8B%E9%82%A8). Official document to read instead: Regulatory Sandbox (ops expansion; not Sandbox X cross-boundary results).

- **2026-09-16** — news.gov.hk (English). Government press summary of the 2026 Policy Address states that to drive growth of the low-altitude economy, an Action Plan will launch cross-boundary logistics trial flights and initiate drafting legislation for heavy unconventional aircraft. [Link](https://www.news.gov.hk/eng/2026/09/20260916/20260916_095230_867.html). Official document to read instead: Action Plan on Developing Low-Altitude Economy (text OPEN; PA-framed); Regulatory Sandbox X / cross-boundary trial pathway; Cap. 448G / unconventional >150 kg drafting watch.

- **2026-09-16** — 香港政府新聞網 (news.gov.hk Chinese). Chinese government news states the Policy Address will formulate the Action Plan on Developing Low-Altitude Economy (發展低空經濟規劃行動綱領), including ASAP cross-boundary low-altitude logistics trial flights and progressive GBA network expansion, Smart Low-altitude Traffic Management System targeting progressive rollout from 2028, and beginning legislation for unconventional aircraft over 150 kg. [Link](https://www.news.gov.hk/chi/2026/09/20260916/20260916_095230_867.html). Official document to read instead: Action Plan (text OPEN); Smart TMS from 2028; >150 kg drafting within 2027 (PA Annex indicators 34–35).

- **2026-09-16** — 香港文匯報 (Wen Wei Po). Wen Wei Po republished the full 2026 Policy Address text, including the low-altitude economy ecosystem section (Sandbox regularisation / Sandbox X testing narrative; ≥15 insurers; Action Plan trio on cross-boundary trials, Smart TMS from 2028, and drafting >150 kg unconventional-aircraft legislation). [Link](https://www.wenweipo.com/a/202609/16/AP6aaa464ae4b01d54a2836d6a.html). Official document to read instead: 2026 Policy Address ¶137–139 (GIA / policyaddress.gov.hk); Regulatory Sandbox / Sandbox X; Working Group / TLB.

- **2026-09-16** — RTHK. RTHK’s Five-Year Plan highlight digest covered the inaugural HKSAR 2026–2030 plan’s seven parts (Northern Metropolis, four centres, GBA, governance) released the same day as the Policy Address, without listing LAE bullets in that digest. [Link](https://news.rthk.hk/rthk/ch/component/k2/1870283-20260916.htm). Official document to read instead: First Five-Year Plan GIA (WEEKLY; Asia-Pacific low-altitude applications hub language is in the GIA summary, not this RTHK digest).

- **2026-09-10** — RTHK. STL Mable Chan said Hong Kong LAE applications have entered a regularisation stage (CAD more than 140 project applications approved since June 2025), that Sandbox X is being pushed for cross-boundary logistics and passenger-capable unconventional aircraft, and that an HK–Kazakhstan cooperation MoU was signed at the Belt and Road Summit covering standards, talent, and regulatory exchange, with Hong Kong’s first five-year plan due the following week. [Link](https://news.rthk.hk/rthk/ch/component/k2/1869548-20260910.htm). Official document to read instead: Regulatory Sandbox / Sandbox X; Working Group on Developing Low-altitude Economy; Action Plan on Developing Low-Altitude Economy (text OPEN); CAD / Cap. 448G.

- **2026-09-10** — China Daily Hong Kong. Coverage of Belt and Road Summit LAE standards session quotes DFS Michael Wong on sandbox approvals and Sandbox X’s further 33 selected projects, and notes a Hong Kong–Nansha (Guangzhou) MoU exchange aimed at cross-boundary testing, regulatory coordination, and technical-standards alignment. [Link](https://www.chinadailyhk.com/hk/article/639379). Official document to read instead: Regulatory Sandbox X (module counts 15+4+5+9 = 33 on TLB page); SZ–HK / GBA cross-boundary operational status remains NOT evidenced on Tracker.

- **2026-09-10** — HKUST. HKUST reported hosting the “Future of Low Altitude Economy” forum with the Working Group and GBA Low Altitude Economy Alliance, including STL remarks on Sandbox X and a witnessed Joint Statement of Intent on Low-Altitude Aviation Standards and Interoperability. [Link](https://hkust.edu.hk/news/hkust-hosts-future-low-altitude-economy-forum). Official document to read instead: Working Group on Developing Low-altitude Economy; Regulatory Sandbox / Sandbox X.

- **2026-09-09** — South China Morning Post. Kazakhstan’s vice-minister of AI and digital development said he signed an MoU with Hong Kong’s Transport and Logistics Bureau at the Belt and Road Summit to launch a transport laboratory and discussed low-altitude economy / traffic-management cooperation. [Link](https://www.scmp.com/news/hong-kong/hong-kong-economy/article/3366910/hong-kong-kazakhstan-sign-mou-transport-lab-discuss-low-altitude-economy). Official document to read instead: none (international MoU watch — speech-attested in WEEKLY; MoU PDF not locked).

- **2026-09-04** — 电商派. Meituan said its Shenzhen drone delivery network in Longhua upgraded hub-and-spoke points into mesh nodes (to 15 points), extending typical merchant delivery reach from about 3 km to 5 km, with Nanshan expansion underway. [Link](https://pai-nextjs.s5.pai.com.cn/news/01m1nj0dkp2z3bn29c14skp0xt). Official document to read instead: none (no Tracker counterpart).

- **2026-09-02** — 南方日报 (via 福建省商务厅 reprint). Shenzhen issued 《深圳市2026年优化口岸营商环境若干措施》 (“19条”), covering stronger SZ–HK cross-border low-altitude logistics coordination, drone customs-clearance models, orderly SZ–HK drone transport trial flights, and study of eVTOL clearance supervision. [Link](https://swt.fujian.gov.cn/xxgk/jgzn/jgcs/dtgxdc/wszx/202609/t20260902_7208045.htm). Official document to read instead: 粤府办〔2024〕6号 (SZ–HK corridor remains planned-trial under Sandbox X; not evidenced as operational on Tracker).

- **2026-09-02** — 见道网 / chinaevtol.org follow-ups (coverage; flight day 2026-08-28; public sessions through ~2026-08-30). Follow-up coverage of Hong Kong’s first public unmanned passenger eVTOL (EH216-S) trial at Cyberport under Regulatory Sandbox X unconventional-aircraft pilots, noting the government’s stated intent to study dedicated unconventional-aircraft legislation toward 2027. [Link](https://www.seetao.com/details/276927.html). Official document to read instead: Regulatory Sandbox X; Working Group on Developing Low-altitude Economy; Cap. 448G / CAD; Action Plan on Developing Low-Altitude Economy (legislation watch — text OPEN).
